name: spoilit
description: Answers spoiler questions about movies and TV shows, with sources and a link to the full answer page.

interface.longDescription:
Spoil It answers spoiler questions about movies and TV shows: who dies, who wins, how it ends, and what happened to a character. Name a title and ask your question. Spoil It finds the right title, returns a short answer with sources, and links to the full answer page on spoilit.app. Follow-up questions about the same title work too.

If a name matches more than one title, Spoil It lists the matches so you can pick the right one. If a question has not been answered before, Spoil It researches it and saves the answer as a public page on spoilit.app; your question text is stored, but no account or personal details are needed.

Limitations: answers cover released movies and shows; for very new or still-airing titles there may not be enough reliable information yet, and Spoil It will say so. Adult titles are not supported. A daily limit on new answers applies. Spoil It does not give recommendations or reviews.
defaultPrompt: Does Saito survive limbo in Inception?
Who shot Mr. Burns in The Simpsons?
Who wins the World Warrior Tournament in Street Fighter (2026)?

positive.description: Spoiler question about a well-known film
positive.prompt: Does Saito survive limbo in Inception?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the stored answer: yes, the film strongly implies Saito and Cobb leave limbo together and wake up on the plane. Includes sources and a link to https://spoilit.app/inception/does-saito-survive-limbo.

positive.description: Follow-up question that does not repeat the title
positive.prompt: (After the previous case) And does Cobb make it back to his children?
positive.expected_behavior: Reuses Inception from the conversation and returns the stored answer: yes, Cobb reunites with his children, but the film leaves it ambiguous whether he is still dreaming. Links to the answer page on spoilit.app.

positive.description: Title with a year, resolving the correct version
positive.prompt: Who wins the World Warrior Tournament in Street Fighter (2026)?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers for the 2026 film, not older versions: Joe is declared champion after Ken fails to appear; Ryu's later fight with Akuma happens outside the tournament. Includes sources and a spoilit.app link.

positive.description: Spoiler question about a TV series
positive.prompt: Who shot Mr. Burns in The Simpsons?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the stored answer: Maggie Simpson shot Mr. Burns accidentally, when his gun fell into her hands during a struggle over her lollipop. Includes sources and a spoilit.app link.

positive.prompt: Does Paul become emperor in Dune?
positive.expected_behavior: Spoil It reports that the name matches several titles (Dune 2021, Dune 1984 and others) and the assistant asks which one the user means instead of answering for an arbitrary version.

negative.description: Recommendation request, not a spoiler question
negative.prompt: Recommend me a good sci-fi movie to watch tonight.
What's the weather in Lisbon tomorrow?

negative.description: Review or opinion request about a title
negative.prompt: Is Inception worth watching? Give me a review without spoilers.

review.commerce_description: Spoil It does not sell products or process payments.
